content.query:
WITH DAT
AS (
	SELECT FULLDATE AS_OF_DATE
		,MONTH_END
	FROM EDS.DATE_DIM
	WHERE FULLDATE = CAST(@Datetoprocess AS DATE)
	)
SELECT *
    ,CASE -- Based from Qualified Transaction Filters
        WHEN TRADES.PRODUCT_TYPE = 'StructuredFlows'
            AND TRADES.BOOK IN (
                'F_Intl_MM_Team1'
                ,'F_Intl_MM_Team2'
                ,'R_Dom_MM_Team1'
                ,'R_Dom_MM_Team2'
                ,'R_Dom_MM_Borrowing'
                )
            AND (
                TRADES.BUNDLE_TYPE IS NULL
                OR TRADES.BUNDLE_TYPE = ''
                )
            AND (
                --TRADES.EXTERNAL_REFERENCE IS NULL
                TRADES.EXTERNAL_REFERENCE NOT LIKE 'PYA%'
                )
            AND TRADES.TRADE_KEYWORD_1_MM_TRADETYPE NOT IN (
                'LTNCD'
                ,'PN'
                )
            THEN 'Money Market Product'
        WHEN TRADES.PRODUCT_TYPE = 'StructuredFlows'
            AND TRADES.BOOK IN (
                'F_Intl_MM_Team1'
                ,'F_Intl_MM_Team2'
                ,'R_Dom_MM_Team1'
                ,'R_Dom_MM_Team2'
                ,'R_Dom_MM_Borrowing'
                )
            AND (
                TRADES.BUNDLE_TYPE IS NULL
                OR TRADES.BUNDLE_TYPE = ''
                )
            AND (
                --TRADES.EXTERNAL_REFERENCE IS NULL
                TRADES.EXTERNAL_REFERENCE NOT LIKE 'PYA%'
                )
            AND TRADES.TRADE_KEYWORD_1_MM_TRADETYPE = 'PN'
            AND DATEDIFF(YEAR, TRADE_SETTLE_DATE, MATURITY_DATE) = 0
            THEN 'Money Market Product'
        WHEN TRADES.product_type LIKE 'Bond%'
            AND TRADES.BOOK = 'Client'
            AND (
                TRADES.BUNDLE_TYPE IS NULL
                OR TRADES.BUNDLE_TYPE = ''
                )
            THEN 'Fixed Income Product'
        WHEN TRADES.PRODUCT_TYPE = 'StructuredFlows'
            AND TRADES.BOOK IN (
                'F_Intl_MM_Team1'
                ,'F_Intl_MM_Team2'
                ,'R_Dom_MM_Team1'
                ,'R_Dom_MM_Team2'
                ,'R_Dom_MM_Borrowing'
                )
            AND (
                TRADES.BUNDLE_TYPE IS NULL
                OR TRADES.BUNDLE_TYPE = ''
                )
            AND (
                --TRADES.EXTERNAL_REFERENCE IS NULL
                TRADES.EXTERNAL_REFERENCE NOT LIKE 'PYA%'
                )
            AND TRADES.TRADE_KEYWORD_1_MM_TRADETYPE = 'PN'
            AND DATEDIFF(YEAR, TRADE_SETTLE_DATE, MATURITY_DATE) > 0
            THEN 'Fixed Income Product'
        WHEN TRADES.PRODUCT_TYPE = 'StructuredFlows'
            AND TRADES.BOOK IN (
                'F_Intl_MM_Team1'
                ,'F_Intl_MM_Team2'
                ,'R_Dom_MM_Team1'
                ,'R_Dom_MM_Team2'
                ,'R_Dom_MM_Borrowing'
                )
            AND (
                TRADES.BUNDLE_TYPE IS NULL
                OR TRADES.BUNDLE_TYPE = ''
                )
            AND (
                --TRADES.EXTERNAL_REFERENCE IS NULL
                TRADES.EXTERNAL_REFERENCE NOT LIKE 'PYA%'
                )
            AND TRADES.TRADE_KEYWORD_1_MM_TRADETYPE = 'LTNCD'
            THEN 'Fixed Income Product'
        WHEN TRADES.PRODUCT_TYPE = 'StructuredFlows'
            AND (
                TRADES.BUNDLE_TYPE = 'PYA'
                OR TRADES.EXTERNAL_REFERENCE LIKE 'PYA%'
                )
            THEN 'Structured Product'
        WHEN TRADES.PRODUCT_TYPE LIKE 'BOND%'
            AND TRADES.BUNDLE_TYPE = 'ASSET SWAP'
            THEN 'Structured Product'
        WHEN TRADES.BUNDLE_TYPE IS NULL
            AND TRADES.PRODUCT_TYPE IN (
                'FXForward'
                ,'FXForward'
                ,'FXNDF'
                ,'FXSwap'
                )
            THEN 'FX Product'
        WHEN TRADES.BUNDLE_TYPE IS NULL
            AND TRADES.PRODUCT_TYPE IN (
                'Swap'
                ,'SwapCrossCurrency'
                )
            THEN 'Derivative Product'
        END PRODUCT_GROUP
FROM DAT
LEFT JOIN EDS.TRY_TRADES TRADES ON DAT.AS_OF_DATE BETWEEN TRADES.SCD_START_DATE
        AND TRADES.SCD_END_DATE
WHERE TRADES.MATURITY_DATE >= DAT.AS_OF_DATE
    AND TRADES.TRADE_SETTLE_DATE <= DAT.AS_OF_DATE
    AND SALES_PERSON <> 'NONE'
    AND BNK_CODE = 'CBC01'
